policy: Select calibration first, then confirmation. Exclude inventoried old titles/IDs/normalized exact contexts/questions; additionally exclude all calibration titles/IDs/normalized exact contexts/questions from confirmation. Use SHA256(str(seed)+title) for eligible article ranking and SHA256(str(seed)+id) for question ranking. Require sixteen unique contexts per answerability class per article. Permit shared contexts between classes within an article. Reject cross-article duplicate questions and context families; fail without fallback when fixed quotas cannot be met. Do not read model outputs or replace samples after outcomes.

scope: Public SQuAD dev local splits, never an official hidden test. Calibration may select the predeclared threshold only, not the model or prompt. Confirmation is reserved for one final frozen-policy evaluation. These samples are new only to the inventoried project datasets; pretraining contamination and semantic near-duplicates are unknown. Results generalize at most to this selected article distribution. Once published or evaluated, future runs are reproductions, not fresh confirmation.
